content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: NCDC has advertised 3 posts in total. Both posts are filled by contractual recruitment. The number of vacancies may be increased or decreased as required. The exact number will be decided by the Corporation, as per requirement, at the time of the interview of shortlisted candidates. The notice gives no category-wise break-up.

rows.contract_period: 3 years, extendable for a maximum period of one year
3 years, extendable for a maximum period of one year

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Both posts need the same educational qualification: a Post Graduate Degree / Executive MBA / Post Graduate Diploma (2 years duration) in Cooperative Management / Cooperative Development / Agri Business / Rural Development or other related fields falling under the Corporation's mandate. Educational qualification, age and experience are determined as on the last date of submission of application. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates with experience especially in agriculture, agri-allied processing works and the export sector will be given preference. Experience in activities related to cooperative organisations and Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs) is desirable. Preference will be given to candidates with experience of work such as formation, strengthening and capacity building of organisations. Value addition/processing activities. Development of market linkages. Promoting the export of value-added products. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.experience: Total 12 years' experience in the relevant field
Total 5 years' experience in the relevant field

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration for both posts is negotiable, as per the candidate's previous/current salary. The remuneration is consolidated and inclusive of applicable taxes; no other facilities or allowances are admissible. Remuneration is paid on a monthly basis, and the annual increment is subject to satisfactory performance. Professionals will be contracted initially for 3 years, which may be extended by 1 year as required, up to a maximum of 4 years, for providing high-quality services on specific projects. Continuation in the post after the first year and in later years depends on a satisfactory annual performance review based on clearly defined key performance indicators. Working hours, travel, daily allowance, leave and similar matters are governed by the provisions applicable to NCDC's contractual appointments.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NCDC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Post applied for (Advisor/Young Professional-II), name, gender, mother's and father's names, date of birth (dd/mm/yyyy). Permanent address, domicile state, marital status, religion, address for correspondence, phone number and email ID. Category (UR/SC/ST/OBC) and sub-category (EWS/Ex-Serviceman/PwD/Other). Languages known (speak, read, write) and educational qualifications from Class 10 to post-graduation and others. Work experience starting with the latest employer, with period, pay, nature of work and sector, plus a brief note on suitability for the post. Declarations on any pending criminal case, past conviction, financial liabilities with the current employer and any conflict of interest, followed by a signed undertaking.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Meeting the eligibility criteria alone does not entitle a candidate to an interview/personal discussion. NCDC may carry out preliminary shortlisting on the basis of academic record, experience and similar factors, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview/personal discussion. The notice does not give an interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NCDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NCDC Advertisement No. 11/2026 has 3 vacancies: 1 Advisor and 2 Young Professional-II (FPO). The number may be increased or decreased as required.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NCDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application is 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the NCDC Advisor and Young Professional-II posts?
faq.answer: Both posts need a Post Graduate Degree / Executive MBA / Post Graduate Diploma (2 years duration) in Cooperative Management / Cooperative Development / Agri Business / Rural Development or other related fields under the Corporation's mandate. The Advisor needs 12 years' and the Young Professional-II (FPO) 5 years' total experience in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NCDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years for the Advisor and 38 years for the Young Professional-II (FPO), determined as on the last date of submission of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NCDC Young Professional-II and Advisor posts?
faq.answer: Remuneration for both posts is negotiable as per previous/current salary. It is consolidated, inclusive of applicable taxes, and paid monthly.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NCDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email the filled prescribed proforma with all self-attested documents and a latest photograph to [email protected] by 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: The subject line must read "Application for Advisor/Young Professional-II" (सलाहकार/युवा पेशेवर-II के लिए आवेदन).

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NCDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NCDC may shortlist candidates on the basis of academic record and experience, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview/personal discussion.

faq.question: Q9. Are the NCDC Advisor and Young Professional-II posts permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely on a contract basis for 3 years, which may be extended by 1 year up to a maximum of 4 years, with no right to regular appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Are any allowances paid on top of the remuneration?
faq.answer: No, the remuneration is consolidated and no other facilities or allowances are admissible; the annual increment is subject to satisfactory performance.
